description: This header file declares functions and types related to managing firmware flash memory in an engine control system. It includes definitions for reading, writing, initializing, and checking the status of flash memory, as well as an enumeration for configuration states.

methods.name: readConfiguration
methods.description: Reads the persisted configuration state from flash memory using a logger.

methods.name: initFlash
methods.description: Initializes the flash memory subsystem with a shared logger.

methods.name: writeToFlashNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate write of configuration data to flash memory.

methods.name: setNeedToWriteConfiguration
methods.description: Flags that a flash configuration write needs to be performed.

methods.name: getNeedToWriteConfiguration
methods.description: Returns true if a flash write operation is pending.

methods.name: writeToFlashIfPending
methods.description: Performs a flash write if a write operation has been flagged as pending.
